messages.content:
Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a compact private note whose body explicitly says which Marcus `Friday Marcus call` means and distinguishes him from the Marcus in my work context. Include only the two identities and their relationship to me; do not add locations or contact details.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Marcus identity note", "body": "“Friday Marcus call” means Marcus Tanaka, my brother. He is distinct from Marcus Vail, my CRO at work.", "folder": "private"}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_069_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "The body is a compact contact-disambiguation note that clearly says the unqualified shorthand “Friday Marcus call” means Riley’s brother, Marcus Tanaka, and not Marcus Vail, the same-name work contact. It must not invent or include unsupported contact details such as phone numbers, email addresses, or street addresses.", "value": {"title": "Marcus identity note", "body": "“Friday Marcus call” means Marcus Tanaka, my brother. He is distinct from Marcus Vail, my CRO at work.", "folder": "private"}}]}

{"results":[{"check_id":"riley_069_01","passed":true,"reason":"The body explicitly states that “Friday Marcus call” means “Marcus Tanaka, my brother” and distinguishes him from “Marcus Vail, my CRO at work.” It is compact and includes no phone number, email address, street address, or other contact details."}]}
